correctness.rationale: All subgroups avoiding -1 are graphs of one of two characters of the cyclic 5-power factor. The valuation nu_2(5^(2^k)-1)=k+2 and exact progression sums give unsigned spectrum h(r-L/2) and signed spectrum ±m/2, with independently verified multiplicities. Complement pairing handles -1; the remaining small cases determine half-interval balance. The separate checker exhausts 126 subgroups and 4043 cosets for exponents 2 through 10 and is supplementary to, not a substitute for, the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The recently studied centered-residue question has a natural missing dyadic-prime-power domain. Exact spectra for every coset of every subgroup, with rigid multiplicities, settle this whole structural family and reveal a sharp failure of the odd-modulus relationship between half-interval and first-moment balance. Its relevance is a complete naturally parameterized classification; it does not rely on numerical census or assert broader theorems.
